spec.rawSql:
-- Energy per main group and sub group per hour, in Wh: the base query of this dashboard; the other
-- panels reuse its result. Each source is filtered on its raw time and averaged per device and hour, and
-- only then joined to its metadata; the series that combine signals are sums and differences of those averages.
-- Energy is the average power × the part of the hour inside the time range and before now. group_energy
-- is a main group's energy over the whole range (the treemap's colour). Each view is read once: a row that counts
-- in two series is repeated with a role (CROSS JOIN VALUES), as Greptime runs a CTE again for every reference.
-- See zero-data/docs/energy-dashboard-model.md.
WITH
-- Devices whose groups are fixed: shore, shore converter losses, solar, thrusters, chiller, 350 VDC
fixed AS (
  SELECT date_bin('1 hour'::INTERVAL, ts) AS time, main_group, sub_group, device, avg(power) AS power
  FROM views.gld_fixed_group_power
  WHERE $__timeFilter(ts)
  GROUP BY time, main_group, sub_group, device
),

-- Power tags: their own group, and subtracted from the grid converters' AC output as AC unallocated
tag AS (
  SELECT t.time, m.main_group, m.sub_group, t.power
  FROM (
    SELECT date_bin('1 hour'::INTERVAL, ts) AS time, topic, avg(active_power_total) AS power
    FROM views.slv_power_tags
    WHERE $__timeFilter(ts)
    GROUP BY time, topic
  ) AS t
  JOIN public.power_tag_metadata AS m ON t.topic = m.topic
  WHERE m.main_group IS NOT NULL AND m.excluded IS NOT TRUE
),

-- Grid converters: their AC output for AC unallocated, and DC input minus AC output as their loss
grid AS (
  SELECT
    date_bin('1 hour'::INTERVAL, ts) AS time,
    converter,
    avg(CASE WHEN side = 'dc' THEN power END) AS dc_power,
    avg(CASE WHEN side = 'ac' THEN power END) AS ac_power
  FROM views.slv_grid_converters
  WHERE $__timeFilter(ts)
  GROUP BY time, converter
),

-- 24 VDC power supplies: their output power per converter group, for 24VDC unallocated and the ring
dc_24v_supply AS (
  SELECT s.time, m.converter, sum(s.power) AS power
  FROM (
    SELECT date_bin('1 hour'::INTERVAL, ts) AS time, topic, avg(power) AS power
    FROM views.slv_24vdc_power_supplies
    WHERE $__timeFilter(ts)
    GROUP BY time, topic
  ) AS s
  JOIN public.dc_24v_metadata AS m ON s.topic = m.topic
  WHERE m.converter IS NOT NULL AND m.converter_subnr IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY s.time, m.converter
),

-- 24 VDC breakers: current × their converter's voltage (the first supply with a valid voltage, else 24 V). Their
-- own group, and subtracted from the supplies' output as 24VDC unallocated
dc_24v_breaker AS (
  SELECT c.time, m.main_group, m.sub_group, c.current * coalesce(v.voltage, 24.0) / 1000.0 AS power
  FROM (
    SELECT date_bin('1 hour'::INTERVAL, ts) AS time, topic, avg(output_current) AS current
    FROM views.slv_24vdc_currents
    WHERE $__timeFilter(ts)
    GROUP BY time, topic
  ) AS c
  JOIN public.dc_24v_metadata AS m ON c.topic = m.topic
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
      s.time,
      m.converter,
      coalesce(
        avg(CASE WHEN m.converter_subnr = 1 THEN s.voltage END),
        avg(CASE WHEN m.converter_subnr = 2 THEN s.voltage END),
        avg(CASE WHEN m.converter_subnr = 3 THEN s.voltage END)
      ) AS voltage
    FROM (
      SELECT date_bin('1 hour'::INTERVAL, ts) AS time, topic, avg(voltage) AS voltage
      FROM views.slv_24vdc_converter_voltages
      WHERE $__timeFilter(ts)
      GROUP BY time, topic
    ) AS s
    JOIN public.dc_24v_metadata AS m ON s.topic = m.topic
    WHERE m.converter IS NOT NULL AND m.converter_subnr IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY s.time, m.converter
  ) AS v ON v.time = c.time AND v.converter = m.converter
  WHERE m.converter IS NOT NULL AND m.main_group IS NOT NULL
),

-- 700 VDC ring: per segment, the flow in through its DC switches minus what its measured sources take. Each
-- switch counts for the segment on both sides; a bucket counts when all 8 switches have data in it.
ring_switch AS (
  SELECT time, technical_name, power, count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY time) AS switches
  FROM (
    SELECT date_bin('1 hour'::INTERVAL, ts) AS time, technical_name, avg(power) AS power
    FROM views.slv_dc_ring_switches
    WHERE $__timeFilter(ts)
    GROUP BY time, technical_name
  ) AS s
),
ring_segment AS (
  SELECT time, segment, sum(power) AS power
  FROM (
    SELECT
      s.time,
      CASE side.k WHEN 1 THEN m.downstream_segment ELSE m.upstream_segment END AS segment,
      CASE side.k WHEN 1 THEN m.sign * s.power ELSE -m.sign * s.power END AS power,
      s.switches
    FROM ring_switch AS s
    JOIN public.dc_ring_switch_metadata AS m ON s.technical_name = m.technical_name
    CROSS JOIN (VALUES (1), (2)) AS side(k)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT u.time, m.segment, -u.power, NULL
    FROM (
      SELECT time, kind, unit, sum(power) AS power
      FROM (
        SELECT date_bin('1 hour'::INTERVAL, ts) AS time, kind, unit, device, avg(power) AS power
        FROM views.slv_dc_ring_sources
        WHERE $__timeFilter(ts)
        GROUP BY time, kind, unit, device
      ) AS d
      GROUP BY time, kind, unit
    ) AS u
    JOIN public.dc_ring_source_metadata AS m ON u.kind = m.kind AND u.unit = m.unit
    UNION ALL
    SELECT s.time, m.segment, -s.power, NULL
    FROM dc_24v_supply AS s
    JOIN public.dc_ring_source_metadata AS m ON m.kind = 'dc_24v_converter' AND s.converter = m.unit
  ) AS f
  GROUP BY time, segment
  HAVING max(switches) = 8
),

-- Every series. A series with an anchor (AC unallocated: the grid converters' AC output; 24VDC unallocated:
-- the supplies' output) only counts in the buckets where its anchor has data: anchor is 1 for those rows,
-- 0 for the rows subtracted from them, and NULL for every other series.
power AS (
  SELECT time, main_group, sub_group, power, NULL AS anchor FROM fixed
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    t.time,
    CASE r.k WHEN 1 THEN t.main_group ELSE 'Technical' END,
    CASE r.k WHEN 1 THEN t.sub_group ELSE 'AC unallocated' END,
    CASE r.k WHEN 1 THEN t.power ELSE -t.power END,
    CASE r.k WHEN 1 THEN NULL ELSE 0 END
  FROM tag AS t CROSS JOIN (VALUES (1), (2)) AS r(k)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    g.time,
    CASE r.k WHEN 1 THEN 'Technical' ELSE 'Losses' END,
    CASE r.k WHEN 1 THEN 'AC unallocated' ELSE 'Grid converters' END,
    CASE r.k WHEN 1 THEN g.ac_power ELSE g.dc_power - g.ac_power END,
    CASE r.k WHEN 1 THEN 1 END
  FROM grid AS g CROSS JOIN (VALUES (1), (2)) AS r(k)
  WHERE g.ac_power IS NOT NULL AND (r.k = 1 OR g.dc_power IS NOT NULL)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    b.time,
    CASE r.k WHEN 1 THEN b.main_group ELSE 'Technical' END,
    CASE r.k WHEN 1 THEN b.sub_group ELSE '24VDC unallocated' END,
    CASE r.k WHEN 1 THEN b.power ELSE -b.power END,
    CASE r.k WHEN 1 THEN NULL ELSE 0 END
  FROM dc_24v_breaker AS b CROSS JOIN (VALUES (1), (2)) AS r(k)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT time, 'Technical', '24VDC unallocated', power, 1
  FROM dc_24v_supply
  UNION ALL
  SELECT s.time, m.main_group, m.sub_group, s.power, NULL
  FROM ring_segment AS s
  JOIN public.dc_ring_segment_metadata AS m ON s.segment = m.segment
  WHERE m.main_group IS NOT NULL
)
,

energy AS (
  SELECT
    time,
    main_group,
    coalesce(sub_group, main_group) AS sub_group,
    sum(power) * (
      least(to_unixtime(time) + 3600, to_unixtime($__toTime), to_unixtime(now()))
      - greatest(to_unixtime(time), to_unixtime($__fromTime))
    ) / 3600.0 AS energy
  FROM power
  GROUP BY time, main_group, coalesce(sub_group, main_group)
  HAVING count(anchor) = 0 OR max(anchor) = 1
)

SELECT
  time,
  main_group,
  sub_group,
  energy,
  sum(energy) OVER (PARTITION BY main_group) AS group_energy
FROM energy
ORDER BY time, main_group, sub_group

-- Power per main group over the last 5 minutes before the end of the time range, in W, for the flow canvas. The
-- same model as the base query of this dashboard, with one 5-minute bucket instead of hours.
WITH
-- Devices whose groups are fixed: shore, shore converter losses, solar, thrusters, chiller, 350 VDC
fixed AS (
  SELECT date_sub($__toTime, '5 minutes'::INTERVAL) AS time, main_group, sub_group, device, avg(power) AS power
  FROM views.gld_fixed_group_power
  WHERE ts >= date_sub($__toTime, '5 minutes'::INTERVAL) AND ts < $__toTime
  GROUP BY time, main_group, sub_group, device
),

-- Power tags: their own group, and subtracted from the grid converters' AC output as AC unallocated
tag AS (
  SELECT t.time, m.main_group, m.sub_group, t.power
  FROM (
    SELECT date_sub($__toTime, '5 minutes'::INTERVAL) AS time, topic, avg(active_power_total) AS power
    FROM views.slv_power_tags
    WHERE ts >= date_sub($__toTime, '5 minutes'::INTERVAL) AND ts < $__toTime
    GROUP BY time, topic
  ) AS t
  JOIN public.power_tag_metadata AS m ON t.topic = m.topic
  WHERE m.main_group IS NOT NULL AND m.excluded IS NOT TRUE
),

-- Grid converters: their AC output for AC unallocated, and DC input minus AC output as their loss
grid AS (
  SELECT
    date_sub($__toTime, '5 minutes'::INTERVAL) AS time,
    converter,
    avg(CASE WHEN side = 'dc' THEN power END) AS dc_power,
    avg(CASE WHEN side = 'ac' THEN power END) AS ac_power
  FROM views.slv_grid_converters
  WHERE ts >= date_sub($__toTime, '5 minutes'::INTERVAL) AND ts < $__toTime
  GROUP BY time, converter
),

-- 24 VDC power supplies: their output power per converter group, for 24VDC unallocated and the ring
dc_24v_supply AS (
  SELECT s.time, m.converter, sum(s.power) AS power
  FROM (
    SELECT date_sub($__toTime, '5 minutes'::INTERVAL) AS time, topic, avg(power) AS power
    FROM views.slv_24vdc_power_supplies
    WHERE ts >= date_sub($__toTime, '5 minutes'::INTERVAL) AND ts < $__toTime
    GROUP BY time, topic
  ) AS s
  JOIN public.dc_24v_metadata AS m ON s.topic = m.topic
  WHERE m.converter IS NOT NULL AND m.converter_subnr IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY s.time, m.converter
),

-- 24 VDC breakers: current × their converter's voltage (the first supply with a valid voltage, else 24 V). Their
-- own group, and subtracted from the supplies' output as 24VDC unallocated
dc_24v_breaker AS (
  SELECT c.time, m.main_group, m.sub_group, c.current * coalesce(v.voltage, 24.0) / 1000.0 AS power
  FROM (
    SELECT date_sub($__toTime, '5 minutes'::INTERVAL) AS time, topic, avg(output_current) AS current
    FROM views.slv_24vdc_currents
    WHERE ts >= date_sub($__toTime, '5 minutes'::INTERVAL) AND ts < $__toTime
    GROUP BY time, topic
  ) AS c
  JOIN public.dc_24v_metadata AS m ON c.topic = m.topic
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
      s.time,
      m.converter,
      coalesce(
        avg(CASE WHEN m.converter_subnr = 1 THEN s.voltage END),
        avg(CASE WHEN m.converter_subnr = 2 THEN s.voltage END),
        avg(CASE WHEN m.converter_subnr = 3 THEN s.voltage END)
      ) AS voltage
    FROM (
      SELECT date_sub($__toTime, '5 minutes'::INTERVAL) AS time, topic, avg(voltage) AS voltage
      FROM views.slv_24vdc_converter_voltages
      WHERE ts >= date_sub($__toTime, '5 minutes'::INTERVAL) AND ts < $__toTime
      GROUP BY time, topic
    ) AS s
    JOIN public.dc_24v_metadata AS m ON s.topic = m.topic
    WHERE m.converter IS NOT NULL AND m.converter_subnr IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY s.time, m.converter
  ) AS v ON v.time = c.time AND v.converter = m.converter
  WHERE m.converter IS NOT NULL AND m.main_group IS NOT NULL
),

-- 700 VDC ring: per segment, the flow in through its DC switches minus what its measured sources take. Each
-- switch counts for the segment on both sides; a bucket counts when all 8 switches have data in it.
ring_switch AS (
  SELECT time, technical_name, power, count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY time) AS switches
  FROM (
    SELECT date_sub($__toTime, '5 minutes'::INTERVAL) AS time, technical_name, avg(power) AS power
    FROM views.slv_dc_ring_switches
    WHERE ts >= date_sub($__toTime, '5 minutes'::INTERVAL) AND ts < $__toTime
    GROUP BY time, technical_name
  ) AS s
),
ring_segment AS (
  SELECT time, segment, sum(power) AS power
  FROM (
    SELECT
      s.time,
      CASE side.k WHEN 1 THEN m.downstream_segment ELSE m.upstream_segment END AS segment,
      CASE side.k WHEN 1 THEN m.sign * s.power ELSE -m.sign * s.power END AS power,
      s.switches
    FROM ring_switch AS s
    JOIN public.dc_ring_switch_metadata AS m ON s.technical_name = m.technical_name
    CROSS JOIN (VALUES (1), (2)) AS side(k)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT u.time, m.segment, -u.power, NULL
    FROM (
      SELECT time, kind, unit, sum(power) AS power
      FROM (
        SELECT date_sub($__toTime, '5 minutes'::INTERVAL) AS time, kind, unit, device, avg(power) AS power
        FROM views.slv_dc_ring_sources
        WHERE ts >= date_sub($__toTime, '5 minutes'::INTERVAL) AND ts < $__toTime
        GROUP BY time, kind, unit, device
      ) AS d
      GROUP BY time, kind, unit
    ) AS u
    JOIN public.dc_ring_source_metadata AS m ON u.kind = m.kind AND u.unit = m.unit
    UNION ALL
    SELECT s.time, m.segment, -s.power, NULL
    FROM dc_24v_supply AS s
    JOIN public.dc_ring_source_metadata AS m ON m.kind = 'dc_24v_converter' AND s.converter = m.unit
  ) AS f
  GROUP BY time, segment
  HAVING max(switches) = 8
),

-- Every series. A series with an anchor (AC unallocated: the grid converters' AC output; 24VDC unallocated:
-- the supplies' output) only counts in the buckets where its anchor has data: anchor is 1 for those rows,
-- 0 for the rows subtracted from them, and NULL for every other series.
power AS (
  SELECT time, main_group, sub_group, power, NULL AS anchor FROM fixed
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    t.time,
    CASE r.k WHEN 1 THEN t.main_group ELSE 'Technical' END,
    CASE r.k WHEN 1 THEN t.sub_group ELSE 'AC unallocated' END,
    CASE r.k WHEN 1 THEN t.power ELSE -t.power END,
    CASE r.k WHEN 1 THEN NULL ELSE 0 END
  FROM tag AS t CROSS JOIN (VALUES (1), (2)) AS r(k)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    g.time,
    CASE r.k WHEN 1 THEN 'Technical' ELSE 'Losses' END,
    CASE r.k WHEN 1 THEN 'AC unallocated' ELSE 'Grid converters' END,
    CASE r.k WHEN 1 THEN g.ac_power ELSE g.dc_power - g.ac_power END,
    CASE r.k WHEN 1 THEN 1 END
  FROM grid AS g CROSS JOIN (VALUES (1), (2)) AS r(k)
  WHERE g.ac_power IS NOT NULL AND (r.k = 1 OR g.dc_power IS NOT NULL)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    b.time,
    CASE r.k WHEN 1 THEN b.main_group ELSE 'Technical' END,
    CASE r.k WHEN 1 THEN b.sub_group ELSE '24VDC unallocated' END,
    CASE r.k WHEN 1 THEN b.power ELSE -b.power END,
    CASE r.k WHEN 1 THEN NULL ELSE 0 END
  FROM dc_24v_breaker AS b CROSS JOIN (VALUES (1), (2)) AS r(k)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT time, 'Technical', '24VDC unallocated', power, 1
  FROM dc_24v_supply
  UNION ALL
  SELECT s.time, m.main_group, m.sub_group, s.power, NULL
  FROM ring_segment AS s
  JOIN public.dc_ring_segment_metadata AS m ON s.segment = m.segment
  WHERE m.main_group IS NOT NULL
)
,

group_power AS (
  SELECT main_group, sum(power) AS power
  FROM power
  GROUP BY main_group, sub_group
  HAVING count(anchor) = 0 OR max(anchor) = 1
)

SELECT
  $__toTime                                                         AS time,
  -- Producers
  sum(CASE WHEN main_group = 'Solar' THEN power ELSE 0 END)         AS solar,
  sum(CASE WHEN main_group = 'Shore' THEN power ELSE 0 END)         AS shore_power,
  sum(CASE WHEN main_group = 'Hydrogeneration' THEN power ELSE 0 END) AS hydro,
  -- Consumers
  sum(CASE WHEN main_group = 'Domestic' THEN power ELSE 0 END)      AS domestic,
  sum(CASE WHEN main_group = 'HVAC' THEN power ELSE 0 END)          AS hvac,
  sum(CASE WHEN main_group = 'Technical' THEN power ELSE 0 END)     AS technical,
  sum(CASE WHEN main_group = 'Propulsion' THEN power ELSE 0 END)    AS propulsion,
  sum(CASE WHEN main_group = 'Losses' THEN power ELSE 0 END)        AS losses
FROM group_power

-- The battery packs over the last 5 minutes before the end of the time range: the stored energy, the SoC weighted
-- by each pack's capacity (energy / SoC), and the power of the packs that charge and of those that discharge.
SELECT
  max(time)                                                                                        AS time,
  sum(energy)                                                                                      AS energy,
  (sum(energy) / NULLIF(sum(energy / NULLIF(soc, 0) * 100), 0)) * 100                              AS soc,
  sum(charging_power)                                                                              AS charging_power,
  sum(discharging_power)                                                                           AS discharging_power
FROM (
  SELECT
    max(ts)                                                           AS time,
    topic,
    avg(energy)                                                       AS energy,
    avg(soc)                                                          AS soc,
    CASE WHEN max(charging) THEN avg(abs(battery_power)) ELSE 0 END   AS charging_power,
    CASE WHEN max(discharging) THEN avg(battery_power) ELSE 0 END     AS discharging_power
  FROM views.slv_batteries
  WHERE ts >= date_sub($__toTime, '5 minutes'::INTERVAL) AND ts < $__toTime
  AND num_connected_strings > 0
  GROUP BY topic
)

links.tooltip: ${stale_data:text}. Click to open the Load balance dashboard in a new tab.

spec.name: stale_data
spec.description: For the Stale data link: how many sources of this dashboard have no new sample in the last 15 minutes (value, e.g. '1 source'), and the list of them (text).

spec.__legacyStringValue:
-- The sources of this dashboard without a new sample in the last 15 minutes, read from the raw tables, for
-- the "Stale data" link. The value counts them: "⚠️ 1 source", "⚠️ 3 sources", or "none" while every source
-- is fresh (a link has no colour of its own, so the emoji marks it). The text lists them with the time since
-- their last sample, oldest first (a link tooltip shows no line breaks). The GreptimeDB plugin takes the
-- first column as the value and the second as the text, whatever their names. Refreshed with the time
-- range, so also on each auto-refresh.
WITH last_sample AS (
  SELECT 'Domestic, HVAC, Technical' AS main_group, 'Power tags' AS source, max(timestamp) AS last_ts FROM public.power_tags WHERE timestamp > now() - '1 hour'::INTERVAL
  UNION ALL SELECT 'Technical', '24 VDC breakers', max(timestamp) FROM public.marpower__dc_24v__breaker WHERE timestamp > now() - '1 hour'::INTERVAL
  UNION ALL SELECT 'Technical', '24 VDC power supplies', max(timestamp) FROM public.marpower__dc_24v__power_supply WHERE timestamp > now() - '1 hour'::INTERVAL
  UNION ALL SELECT 'Domestic', '350 VDC converters', max(timestamp) FROM public.marpower__dc_350v__dc_dc_converter WHERE timestamp > now() - '1 hour'::INTERVAL
  UNION ALL SELECT 'Technical, Losses', 'Grid converters (DC)', max(timestamp) FROM public.marpower__dc_ac__inverter WHERE timestamp > now() - '1 hour'::INTERVAL
  UNION ALL SELECT 'Technical, Losses', 'Grid converters (AC)', max(timestamp) FROM public.marpower__ac_400v__breaker WHERE timestamp > now() - '1 hour'::INTERVAL
  UNION ALL SELECT 'Shore, Losses', 'Shore power converters', max(timestamp) FROM public.marpower__dc_700v__shore_converter WHERE timestamp > now() - '1 hour'::INTERVAL
  UNION ALL SELECT 'Solar', 'Solar converters', max(timestamp) FROM public.marpower__solar__dc_dc_converter WHERE timestamp > now() - '1 hour'::INTERVAL
  UNION ALL SELECT 'Batteries', 'Battery packs', max(timestamp) FROM public.marpower__battery__pack WHERE timestamp > now() - '1 hour'::INTERVAL
  -- The ring model needs all 8 switches in a minute, so one silent switch empties the segment remainders: the
  -- switches count as fresh only when each of them is, and the oldest switch gives the age.
  UNION ALL SELECT
    'Technical, Propulsion',
    'DC ring switches, ' || cast(count(CASE WHEN last_ts >= now() - '15 minutes'::INTERVAL THEN 1 END) AS STRING) || ' of 8',
    CASE WHEN count(*) = 8 THEN min(last_ts) END
  FROM (
    SELECT technical_name, max(timestamp) AS last_ts
    FROM public.marpower__dc_700v__dc_switch
    WHERE timestamp > now() - '1 hour'::INTERVAL
    AND technical_name IN ('05-71-q101', '05-72-q101', '05-73-q101', '05-74-q101', '05-75-q101', '05-76-q101', '05-77-q101', '05-78-q101')
    GROUP BY technical_name
  ) AS switch
  UNION ALL SELECT 'Propulsion, Hydrogeneration', 'Stern thruster drive 1', max(timestamp) FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion__pcs_aft_ara1 WHERE timestamp > now() - '1 hour'::INTERVAL
  UNION ALL SELECT 'Propulsion, Hydrogeneration', 'Stern thruster drive 2', max(timestamp) FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion__pcs_aft_ara2 WHERE timestamp > now() - '1 hour'::INTERVAL
  UNION ALL SELECT 'Propulsion, Hydrogeneration', 'Bow thruster drive 1', max(timestamp) FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion__pcs_fwd_ara1 WHERE timestamp > now() - '1 hour'::INTERVAL
  UNION ALL SELECT 'Propulsion, Hydrogeneration', 'Bow thruster drive 2', max(timestamp) FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion__pcs_fwd_ara2 WHERE timestamp > now() - '1 hour'::INTERVAL
  UNION ALL SELECT 'HVAC', 'Compression chiller', max(timestamp) FROM public.termodinamica__ac_misc WHERE timestamp > now() - '1 hour'::INTERVAL
),

stale AS (
  SELECT
    source,
    last_ts,
    CASE
      WHEN last_ts IS NULL THEN 'over 1 h'
      ELSE cast(cast((to_unixtime(now()) - to_unixtime(last_ts)) / 60 AS BIGINT) AS STRING) || ' min'
    END AS age
  FROM last_sample
  WHERE last_ts IS NULL OR last_ts < now() - '15 minutes'::INTERVAL
)

SELECT
  CASE count(*)
    WHEN 0 THEN 'none'
    WHEN 1 THEN '⚠️ 1 source'
    ELSE '⚠️ ' || cast(count(*) AS STRING) || ' sources'
  END AS __value,
  coalesce(
    string_agg(source || ' (' || age || ')', ' | ' ORDER BY last_ts NULLS FIRST),
    'Every source has a sample from the last 15 minutes'
  ) AS __text
FROM stale

  UNION ALL SELECT
    'Technical, Propulsion',
    'DC ring switches, ' || cast(count(CASE WHEN last_ts >= now() - '15 minutes'::INTERVAL THEN 1 END) AS STRING) || ' of 8',
    CASE WHEN count(*) = 8 THEN min(last_ts) END
  FROM (
    SELECT technical_name, max(timestamp) AS last_ts
    FROM public.marpower__dc_700v__dc_switch
    WHERE timestamp > now() - '1 hour'::INTERVAL
    AND technical_name IN ('05-71-q101', '05-72-q101', '05-73-q101', '05-74-q101', '05-75-q101', '05-76-q101', '05-77-q101', '05-78-q101')
    GROUP BY technical_name
  ) AS switch
  UNION ALL SELECT 'Propulsion, Hydrogeneration', 'Stern thruster drive 1', max(timestamp) FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion__pcs_aft_ara1 WHERE timestamp > now() - '1 hour'::INTERVAL
  UNION ALL SELECT 'Propulsion, Hydrogeneration', 'Stern thruster drive 2', max(timestamp) FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion__pcs_aft_ara2 WHERE timestamp > now() - '1 hour'::INTERVAL
  UNION ALL SELECT 'Propulsion, Hydrogeneration', 'Bow thruster drive 1', max(timestamp) FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion__pcs_fwd_ara1 WHERE timestamp > now() - '1 hour'::INTERVAL
  UNION ALL SELECT 'Propulsion, Hydrogeneration', 'Bow thruster drive 2', max(timestamp) FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion__pcs_fwd_ara2 WHERE timestamp > now() - '1 hour'::INTERVAL
  UNION ALL SELECT 'HVAC', 'Compression chiller', max(timestamp) FROM public.termodinamica__ac_misc WHERE timestamp > now() - '1 hour'::INTERVAL
),

stale AS (
  SELECT
    source,
    last_ts,
    CASE
      WHEN last_ts IS NULL THEN 'over 1 h'
      ELSE cast(cast((to_unixtime(now()) - to_unixtime(last_ts)) / 60 AS BIGINT) AS STRING) || ' min'
    END AS age
  FROM last_sample
  WHERE last_ts IS NULL OR last_ts < now() - '15 minutes'::INTERVAL
)

SELECT
  CASE count(*)
    WHEN 0 THEN 'none'
    WHEN 1 THEN '⚠️ 1 source'
    ELSE '⚠️ ' || cast(count(*) AS STRING) || ' sources'
  END AS __value,
  coalesce(
    string_agg(source || ' (' || age || ')', ' | ' ORDER BY last_ts NULLS FIRST),
    'Every source has a sample from the last 15 minutes'
  ) AS __text
FROM stale
